action: Retrieve a tomato from the refrigerator.
done_when: Tomato is in hand and refrigerator door is closed.

action: Rinse the tomato under running tap water.
done_when: Tomato is washed and faucet is turned off.

action: Dry the tomato with a paper towel.
done_when: Tomato surface is wiped dry with the paper towel.

action: Set a wooden cutting board and tomato on the counter.
done_when: Tomato rests on the cutting board on the counter.

action: Slice the tomato into rounds with a knife.
done_when: Tomato is cut into even slices on the board.

action: Take a clean plate from the dishwasher.
done_when: Plate is held near the counter and dishwasher is closed.

action: Arrange the tomato slices onto the plate.
done_when: Tomato slices are laid flat on the plate on the stove.

action: Measure and sprinkle black pepper over the tomatoes.
done_when: Tomato slices are evenly coated with black pepper.

action: Shake salt over the tomato slices.
done_when: Salt is sprinkled on the tomatoes and shaker is replaced.

action: Sprinkle dried herb seasoning onto the tomatoes.
done_when: Dried herbs cover the tomatoes and jar is returned to cabinet.

action: Top the tomato slices with shredded mozzarella cheese.
done_when: Shredded cheese covers the tomatoes and bag is back in fridge.

action: Drizzle olive oil over the mozzarella-topped tomatoes.
done_when: Olive oil coats the tomatoes and bottle is put back.
